“哥哥~我错了！”

沈珩被狠狠地噎住了。

这丫头上来就放大招？！

“再喊一声。”他忍着笑。

“啊？”轮到韩小汐反应不过来了。

“再喊一声，就原谅你。”沈珩倾过身子，靠近她。

不会要亲她吧？！

韩小汐下意识地绷直身子，用小的不能再小的声音喊了一声：“哥哥…

“究竟怎么了风尘老弟？”斟酌了再三，冷墓还是决定询问清楚究竟发生了什么事情。

普通人自然会被这种完全不符合本世界画风的“怪物”吓得魂不附体。而受过教育见过世面的施法者则一定能猜出，那些分明就是某种构装傀儡。

"Brother~I was wrong!"

Shen Heng was choked severely.

Is this girl going to make big moves when she comes up?!

"Shout again." He suppressed a laugh.

"Ah?" It was Han Xiaoxi's turn to react.

"Shout again and I'll forgive you." Shen Heng leaned over and got closer to her.

You're not going to kiss her, are you?!

Han Xiaoxi straightened her body subconsciously and shouted in a voice as soft as possible: "Brother...

"What's going on, brother Fengchen?"After careful consideration, Leng Tomb decided to ask what exactly happened.

Ordinary people will naturally be scared out of their wits by this kind of "monster" that is completely inconsistent with the style of this world.An educated spellcaster who has seen the world will definitely be able to guess that those are clearly some kind of constructed puppets.
